title: Cocaine
plot_overview: In Mumbai, a powerful drug cartel controls the cocaine trade with help from corrupt officials. A dedicated police inspector becomes trapped between enforcing the law and protecting his brother after the cartel targets his family, forcing him into a dangerous struggle for survival.
will_you_like_this: You’ll enjoy this if you like tense Indian crime thrillers such as Aazam or Hit: The First Case; Not for you if you prefer lighter stories or straightforward heroes.
review_summary: Pros: gripping crime premise; tense moral conflict; perilous Mumbai setting | Cons: familiar crime themes; limited review consensus
